# The public project atlas

[← Back to the profile](../README.md) · [Research map](project-map.md) · [Evidence ledger](../experiments/README.md) · [The archive, read as strata](../experiments/archive.md)

<!-- Generated by tools/build_atlas.py from docs/atlas.json. Edit the JSON, then run the script. -->

Every public project in one place, arranged by the six doors on the [front page](../README.md#choose-a-door). The exhibition there is curated; this atlas is meant to be complete. Each entry says what the project is, what you can do with it today, and how far along it is. Archived experiments and forks are at the end, kept for the record.

**29 current projects · 8 archived experiments and forks · reviewed 21 October 2026.** ◆ marks a project featured on the profile's front page.

## How to read the maturity labels

| Label | Means |
| --- | --- |
| Playable world | A world or game you can open in a browser now. |
| Live web app | An interactive application you can use in a browser now, without installing anything. |
| Desktop preview | An installable developer preview; downloads are unsigned and real-device testing is incomplete. |
| Research instrument | Runnable code that produces recorded, inspectable results with stated limits. |
| Simulated research | Experiments that run on simulated or synthetic data only. |
| Executable prototype | Runs from the repository; not yet validated in the field or by other people. |
| Hardware design | Designs, models and simulations; nothing has been fabricated. |
| Library | A package or command-line tool for your own data. |
| Paper | A written proposal with stated predictions; untested. |
| Website | A public site whose source code is not public. |
| Archived | Preserved as part of the record and no longer developed. |
| Fork | Another project's repository, kept for a contribution or as a starting point. |

A label describes what exists, not whether a claim is true. The [evidence ledger](../experiments/README.md) records, separately, what each experiment has shown and under which conditions. A live demo or a passing build never moves a project up that ladder.

Older work stays public when it is part of the record. These repositories are archived or are forks of other people's projects; [the archive, read as strata](../experiments/archive.md) tells how the earlier experiments became the current ones.

| --- | --- | --- |
| **[james_library](https://github.com/topherchris420/james_library)** | The original R.A.I.N. Lab runtime, whose dated experiments remain historical evidence; its Rust layer descends from ZeroClaw, and the lab now lives in Lop Nur Twin. | Archived |
| **[NIST metric proposal](https://github.com/topherchris420/ai-metrology-submissions)** | One proposal on a branch: the established selective-risk-at-target-coverage metric, submitted through the NIST AI Metrology Center's public community process; not merged as of 21 October 2026, and no endorsement is implied. *(fork of usnistgov/ai-metrology-submissions)* | Fork · [Proposal ↗](https://github.com/topherchris420/ai-metrology-submissions/blob/ff442fdfa56cc2fe4b18e087a5c5e9b6559a8e49/submissions/selective-risk-at-target-coverage.yml) |

| **[Resona](https://github.com/topherchris420/resona-lab-network)** | A social site where researchers post projects and others resonate with, fork and discuss them; no longer maintained. | Archived |
| **[DC news prototype](https://github.com/topherchris420/washingtondc-news)** | A prototype local-news landing page with weather and puzzle-style easter eggs; never a news outlet, and its placeholder headlines are invented. | Archived |
| **[Signal Lab](https://github.com/topherchris420/fartscroll)** | A one-page waveform console with sliders and an optional tone, kept in a repository that began as a fork of someone else's browser prank. *(fork of chriswindings/fartscroll)* | Archived · [Open ↗](https://woodyard.vercel.app/) |
| **[Sergeant Carney](https://github.com/topherchris420/Sergeant_Carney)** | A chat experiment in which a language model role-plays Sgt. William Harvey Carney in nineteenth-century diction; his replies are model-generated and may be wrong. *(fork of tonykipkemboi/groq_streamlit_demo)* | Archived |
| **[GitSocial agent skill](https://github.com/topherchris420/gitsocial-agent-skill)** | An unmodified reference copy of gitsocial-org's skill that teaches coding agents the GitSocial command line; the work is theirs. *(fork of gitsocial-org/gitsocial-agent-skill)* | Fork |

Twenty-four earlier experiments from 2024–2025 have since been made private, as have the source repositories of Waveform, Dynamic Location Theory and DNA Music Molecules. Their descriptions stay in [the archive record](../experiments/archive.md); their links are not repeated here because they no longer resolve.

## Keeping the atlas complete

The data lives in [`atlas.json`](atlas.json); [`tools/build_atlas.py`](../tools/build_atlas.py) writes this page and the atlas block on the front page. A scheduled workflow runs `python3 tools/build_atlas.py --discover`, which lists public repositories that are not in the atlas yet and entries whose repositories stopped being public. Adding one is an editorial act: read the repository, write one entry that describes what is implemented, and run the build. Featuring it on the front page is a separate decision.
